headline: MYST's Mechanical Age is now a place you walk
lede: Stage 1 of bringing MYST closer to the 1993 original: the tower world is five linked views with the cage-and-latch puzzle that locked the original's control room.

notes.text: Mechanical grows from 1 view to 5: tower base, cage, gantry, control room, landing — 18 nodes total.
The original's interlocks are real now: the cage jams the door at the landing, the door bangs shut behind you, plates hold only while you stand on them unless you throw the latch.
The SPECTATOR sphere in the control room shows the other Ages.
mystcheck 99→151 gates; 14 mutants (3 new interlock breaks) all die; all 18 views framing-checked.

look.text: Climb the tower — call the cage, latch the plates, meet the SPECTATOR
